Package com.composum.sling.platform.staging.replication.json

Class NodeAttributeComparisonInfo

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.composum.sling.platform.staging.replication.json.NodeAttributeComparisonInfo
  • public class NodeAttributeComparisonInfo
extends Object
    JSON-(de-)serializable description of a nodes attributes, meant for the comparison of the attributes of parent nodes (not for transmitting the attributes - it's not necessary to write attributes back from this representation). We do not support binary attributes - these are meant to be kept in versionables.

    • Field Detail

      • cacheProtectedProperties

        protected static final Map<org.apache.sling.api.resource.ResourceResolver,​Map<String,​List<String>>> cacheProtectedProperties
        Caches for each nodetype (primary and mixin) which properties are protected. We cache this for one resolver only, since that automatically clears the cache without needing to resort to timing etc.

      • IGNORED_ATTRIBUTES

        protected static final com.composum.sling.core.filter.StringFilter IGNORED_ATTRIBUTES
        Attributes that legitimately can be different on the remote side / don't matter for the purpose of our comparison. (The change number is compared elsewhere and would just confuse people.)

      • IMPORTANT_ATTRIBUTES

        protected static final com.composum.sling.core.filter.StringFilter IMPORTANT_ATTRIBUTES
        Attributes to be included even if they are protected.

      • path

        public String path
        The absolute path to the node.

      • propertyHashes

        public Map<String,​String> propertyHashes
        Maps the property names of not protected properties to their String value, or hashes of their value if it's a long string or a data structure. Protected properties are not mentioned, since they cannot be changed, anyway.

    • Method Detail

      • of

        @NotNull
public static @NotNull NodeAttributeComparisonInfo of​(@NotNull
                                                      @NotNull org.apache.sling.api.resource.Resource resource,
                                                      @Nullable
                                                      @Nullable Function<String,​String> pathMapping)
        Creates the information about one node. This uses JCR since that's the easiest way to exclude protected attributes without having to enumerate all protected attribute names.
        Parameters:
        resource - the resource for which we have to compute the attribute info
        pathMapping - if given, we pass the path through this mapping
        Throws:
        IllegalArgumentException - if the path of the resource does not start with the given pathOffset

      • protectedProperties

        protected static Set<String> protectedProperties​(org.apache.sling.api.resource.Resource resource)
                                          throws javax.jcr.RepositoryException
        Returns a list of protected properties.

        We need to check this by hand, since the staging resource manager does not support Property.getDefinition(), and is would be a rather large effort to implement this.

        Throws:
        javax.jcr.RepositoryException

      • stringRep

        protected static String stringRep​(javax.jcr.Property prop,
                                  com.google.common.hash.HashFunction hash)
                           throws javax.jcr.RepositoryException,
                                  IOException
        Creates a String representation of the property that is limited in size (long / complicated properties are hashed). The representation is meant to be of small size, but make it extremely unlikely that different values have the same representation. It is prefixed with the property type.
        Throws:
        javax.jcr.RepositoryException
        IOException
